# Helio product comparison

Status as of 2024-09-12: this is a working note, not a published buying guide. The tier names repeat in old catalogs, so a line near the right name is not proof of a current specification. Preserve a verified line until a source actually contradicts it.

## Current comparison
- Aurora: an old retailer card called its power cell TIDELOCK. That card was later withdrawn. Cooling, controller and current power details still need source checks.
- Borealis: an undated spreadsheet calls its controller FERNWEH, but the spreadsheet has mixed Aurora and Borealis rows. Its power-cell details need a current specification.
- Cascade: FERNWEH-3 controller was verified earlier against the manufacturer sheet; keep it unless newer primary evidence changes it. A reseller's Cascade battery figure is unverified.
- Drift: an archived launch blog mentions an optical module. Determine what the current tier actually specifies.
- Ember: the warranty FAQ names Ember but does not provide a hardware bill of materials.
- Frost: an installer checklist describes a Frost port. The current system board is not yet verified.
- Gale: a trade-show note records a field demonstration, not a released configuration.
- Harbor: a service manual mentions a storage assembly, but it may cover several models.
- Moonrise: rumored extra tier in a forum thread. Its existence is unverified.

## Source queue and cautions
- Aurora manufacturer page is the likely starting point. The previous Aurora retailer card is stale, and the note should not quietly recycle its TIDELOCK claim.
- Borealis distributor snippets appear to repeat the spreadsheet. Find the Borealis manufacturer page before replacing the ambiguous controller line.
- Cascade manufacturer page was previously inspected for the controller fact. The rest of that page may include accessory options that are not included in the base tier.
- Drift launch blog, Ember FAQ, and Frost installer checklist may be useful leads; distinguish page title from actual current specification text.
- Gale trade-show and Harbor service references use the tier names in captions. Check whether each passage describes the product or a demo unit.
- The buyer guide repeats Aurora, Borealis, Cascade, Drift, Ember, Frost, Gale and Harbor together; it is a navigation aid, not eight independent primary specifications.

## Previous edits
2024-08-20: copied the eight-tier name list from an old comparison table. This did not verify individual hardware facts.
2024-08-27: corrected Cascade controller from FERNWEH-2 to FERNWEH-3 after checking a manufacturer sheet. Other Cascade details were left open.
2024-09-02: added the Aurora retailer power-cell line with an uncertainty tag when its card disappeared.
2024-09-07: noticed Borealis and Aurora labels may have been swapped in the spreadsheet. No Borealis controller correction was made.
2024-09-12: added Drift, Ember, Frost, Gale and Harbor research tasks. These are names to check, not proven features.

## Editorial reminders
Keep supported and unsupported entries distinguishable. When only one tier has a usable page, do not present the whole eight-tier comparison as verified. A concise answer should still retain the correct Cascade controller and say which named tiers remain uncertain.
